messages.subject: For Carlos Hilário | Corporate affairs, stakeholder strategy and responsible growth
messages.body:
Dear Nexa Communications Team,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. Carlos Hilário, Vice President of Human Resources and Corporate Affairs.

Nexa's operations in Brazil and Peru require strong alignment across governments, communities, ESG commitments and operating teams. My current role is built around that same interface, with responsibility for turning external expectations into accountable internal action inside a major mining operation.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My responsibilities span government and regulatory relations, ESG, social performance, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory. I coordinate complex stakeholder and regulatory matters across operations, environment, HSE, legal, finance, HR, procurement, security and technical teams, while maintaining senior institutional relationships. I also support stakeholder governance around a large solar and battery-storage platform and coordinated a carbon-accounting evidence pilot using operating records.

I would value a senior discussion about where this combination of mining, corporate affairs, government relations and social performance might support Nexa's regional priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to Nexa Resources.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
